name: agent-config
description: Generates and manages the full agent/sub-agent configuration for any project following the agentskills.io standard. Scaffolds AGENTS.md files, SKILL.md stubs, setup.sh, sync tooling, and multi-AI-assistant support (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot).

project_name.description: Name of your project (used in generated AGENTS.md headers)

default_scope.description: Default scope for new skills: root | ui | api | sdk (default: root)
